interpretations: Match telescopes to observatories with an inner join on observstation, so unmatched telescopes are dropped. Group by lunarstage with NULL as its own group. Each phase average ignores NULL bandusagepct. The threshold is the unweighted mean of all phase averages, and phases are kept only if strictly above it. Telescope count means all matched telescopes in the kept phases, including those with NULL bandusagepct. The three outputs are the mean of the kept phase averages, the total telescope count, and the mean of (phase average − threshold)
Same as above, but the telescope count includes only telescopes with non-NULL bandusagepct
Same as the first, but the threshold is the pooled average bandusagepct over all matched telescopes (weighted by telescope count), not the mean of the phase averages
Same as the first, but phases with an undefined average (all bandusagepct NULL) are excluded from the threshold mean. They are also not kept, since their average is NULL
Same as the first, but phases above or equal to the threshold are kept (non-strict comparison)
Same as the first, but the third value is the average relative excess, (phase average − threshold) / threshold, instead of the absolute difference
Same as the first, but the third value is the average percentage excess over the threshold, 100 × (phase average − threshold) / threshold
Same as the first, but NULL and empty-string lunarstage values are merged into one "missing" group
Same as the first, but lunarstage values that differ only in case or whitespace are normalized into one group
Same as the first, but the third value is the total excess (sum of differences) over the kept phases, not the average
Same as the first, but the third value is computed over all phases, with negative differences for phases below the threshold, rather than over the kept phases
Same as the first, but the first value is the telescope-weighted average bandusagepct over the kept phases, not the unweighted mean of their phase averages
Same as the first, but the third value is the telescope-weighted average of the kept phases' excess over the threshold, not the unweighted average
Same as the first, but telescopes with a NULL `lunarstage` (the missing phase) are excluded entirely, so they form no group and don't enter the threshold
Same as the first, but the threshold is the median of all the phase averages, not the mean
Same as the first, but the third value is the ratio of the kept phases' average to the threshold, not the difference
queries:
WITH phase AS (
  SELECT o.lunarstage AS lunarstage,
         AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_usage,
         COUNT(*) AS tcount
  FROM telescopes t
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.lunarstage
),
thr AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_usage) AS threshold FROM phase
)
SELECT AVG(p.avg_usage) AS mean_of_kept_phase_averages,
       SUM(p.tcount) AS total_telescope_count,
       AVG(p.avg_usage - thr.threshold) AS mean_difference_from_threshold
FROM phase p
CROSS JOIN thr
WHERE p.avg_usage > thr.threshold;
SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
FROM observatories o
LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation AND t.bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY o.observstation;
SELECT t.telescregistry
FROM telescopes t
JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
WHERE t.bandusagepct > (
  SELECT AVG(t2.bandusagepct)
  FROM telescopes t2
  JOIN observatories o2 ON t2.observstation = o2.observstation
  WHERE o2.lunarstage IS NOT NULL
);
WITH phase_avg AS (
  SELECT o.lunarstage AS lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_usage
  FROM telescopes t
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.lunarstage
)
SELECT lunarstage
FROM phase_avg
WHERE avg_usage > (SELECT AVG(avg_usage) FROM phase_avg WHERE avg_usage IS NOT NULL);
